# The Loyalty Loop

> A digital loyalty-card platform for independent neighbourhood shops. Customers discover local cafés, salons and other small businesses, join their digital loyalty cards, and collect stamps or points toward rewards. Business owners run their loyalty programme, staff access, and customer analytics from a companion dashboard and mobile apps.

## What it does

- Customers can keep loyalty cards, stamps, rewards and shop updates in one place.
- Businesses can create a rewards programme, generate a customer QR poster, scan customer codes and view loyalty analytics.
- The service is built for independent high-street businesses, beginning in South London.

- Homepage: https://www.the-loyalty-loop.com/
- Sign up as a shopper: https://www.the-loyalty-loop.com/signup
- Sign up as a business owner: https://www.the-loyalty-loop.com/signup/owner

## Important notes

- The customer dashboard and business tools are account-only and should not be treated as public content.
- Shop information, rewards and availability are provided by each business and can change.

Most of the app (customer dashboard, business owner tools) sits behind account sign-in and is not publicly crawlable content — the pages above are the public entry points.
